notes: Apply sender-current-ack-diagnostic.patch to 33eea6f for baseline; apply it to aa1ca3d for retained suffix (offsets may differ). Both retain current startup-clock, packet-round window evidence, indexed loss scan, 64-datagram DATA burst, 4 MiB/s control ceiling and PMTU discovery.

ACK actual_queue equals handoff plus owner_service. Stale cached-turn offset is recorded separately. Control wait sums required future control delays and excludes wakeup lateness. Reason categories overlap on tied eligibility deadlines.

ACK summaries use before/sent worker0 load-only snapshots and their monotonic interval. Ordinary run counters include drain; sample goodput excludes drain. 100% CPU is one core. Controller gauges are excluded from additive counter totals.
Each build uses four 20-second retained-daemon points in a separate no-NIC container. No builds or tests overlap load.
Neither the 20 Gbit/s local gate nor the real-path gate is met; these observations do not establish a CPU ceiling.
